newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT plans $250-300 mln bond issue in 1997.
newsitem.headline: PLDT plans $250-300 mln bond issue in 1997.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) said on Monday it plans to float $250 million to $300 million worth of bonds by the first quarter of 1997.
"We are looking at the first quarter of 1997 to float $250 to $300 million worth of bonds in Asia, United States and Europe," PLDT executive vice-president Edgardo Del Fonso told Reuters.
Proceeds of the global bond issue will be used to finance in part the 5.4 billion peso expansion programme of the company covering the years 1996 to 1999, Del Fonso said.
Of the 5.4 billion, Del Fonso said 4.4 billion pesos would be sourced from suppliers' credit and internally generated cash. The remaining one billion would be raised through equity and debt.
Last June, PLDT had issued $250 million worth of bonds, Del Fonso said.
